brief:
Historian and writer Assal Rad contends that disparities in Western media coverage of the Gaza war versus Ukraine reflect deliberate collusion, rejecting the notion that such differences occur by chance, Shehab Wire reported. Rad argues the divergence reflects how Western media engages with narratives surrounding Gaza.

The analysis addresses broader patterns in international news coverage and editorial decisions shaping public understanding of armed conflicts in different regions.
